turns.reply:
`python3 roster.py inactive` now lists every learner whose last login was 14 or more days ago, with their email, last login date and how long ago that was. Run against the current data today, it gives:

```
L-002  Ben Whitlock         ben.w@example.org        2026-09-02  (32 days ago)
L-004  Dara Novak           dara@example.org         2026-08-11  (54 days ago)
```

I also checked the boundary: someone at exactly 14 days is included, and at 13 days is not.

The threshold is the `INACTIVE_AFTER_DAYS` constant at the top of `roster.py`. The list is sorted by name, like the other commands, and I added the new command to the usage text and the README.
